name: Konvertek Antriebselektronik GmbH
summary: Konvertek is a group-owned Austrian maker of frequency converters with 800 staff and EUR 196 M turnover, and financially sound (credit index 178, stable; equity 38.4 %). Its list price is head-office policy: no discounts this year, one list for all customers until June 2027, and moves above 2 % go to a pricing committee. It openly invites talks on logistics and payment terms. It is also dealing with a power-semiconductor shortage and is reviewing small accounts, and we are a small account at 0.6 % of its turnover.

situation.decision_maker: Key account manager up to 2 % price change; above 2 % the pricing committee (meets every two weeks); discount policy set by head office; sales director decides account focus

negotiation_pattern: Asked for small annual increases (3.2 %, 1.0 %, 2.8 %) and settled at 0.0 % every time, so it does not fight hard on increases. Defends the list price by policy rather than by argument: 'discounts not possible this year (head-office directive)' and 'price list applies to all customers without exception'. It redirects to payment and logistics conditions. Price on part:350021 fell from 702.43 (2024 award) to 684.92 and has been held flat since.
wants: Volume and account size (focus on customers with volume)
Reliable, on-time payment (we pay late on 85 % of invoices)
Forecast and allocation planning under the semiconductor shortage
Room for a list-price move after June 2027
protects: unit_price (group list-price policy, head-office directive; anything above 2 % needs the pricing committee)

trades.give: Skonto structure on payment_days (e.g. payment within 10 days) plus strict on-time payment
trades.get: Skonto percentage as an effective price reduction without touching the list price
trades.why: It offers to discuss payment conditions; skonto is not a list-price discount, so it fits the head-office policy.

trades.give: contract_months: extend beyond 2027-06-30 (e.g. +12-24 months) with a rolling volume_per_year forecast
trades.get: Price hold through the extension (no increase after June 2027) and lead_time_days / allocation commitment
trades.why: The list is only fixed until June 2027 and it is prioritising volume accounts; forecast security helps its shortage planning.

trades.give: volume_per_year: open a share of part:350020 (currently quota 0, quoted 466.99)
trades.get: Better 350020 price within the KAM's 2 % authority or via the committee, plus a delivery-priority commitment
trades.why: Bundling volume makes us a bigger account; its 350020 quote rose 8.8 % from 429.18 to 466.99.

trades.give: incoterm / logistics flexibility (e.g. consolidated call-offs, FCA pickup if cheaper for us)
trades.get: Logistics credit or a shorter, firmer lead_time_days
trades.why: It explicitly offered to discuss logistics.

arguments.point: Our spend is growing (EUR 0.99 M → 1.26 M → 1.27 M) and could grow further with part:350020, which makes us a volume account worth keeping.
OTD is 81.5 % against the 95 % contractual target, so we need firm lead-time and allocation commitments before adding volume.
Keep requested price moves at or below 2 % so the KAM can agree without the pricing committee and the deal closes faster.
Skonto and payment conditions are not list-price discounts, so they are compatible with its head-office directive.

avoid: Demanding a list-price cut on part:350021: policy blocks it, and the should-cost (no margin) is already 1.2 % above the price, although confidence in that estimate is only 5 %.
Threatening to switch over a few percent; we are 0.6 % of its turnover and it is pruning small accounts.
Asking for longer payment_days while we already pay late on 85 % of invoices.
Expecting quick answers on moves above 2 %; they wait for the biweekly committee.
tone: Businesslike and structured. Accept its list policy, frame offers as payment, logistics and volume terms, and make it easy for the KAM to get internal approval.
red_flags: Power-semiconductor shortage with extended lead times; OTD stuck at 81.5 % against a 95 % target.
It is reviewing small accounts, so there is a risk of deprioritisation or allocation cuts for us.
List price is guaranteed only until June 2027, the same date the contract ends (auto-extends unless terminated with 90 days' notice), so expect an increase push from July 2027.
Part:350021 is 100 % single-sourced here; the other source would need time given the 84-day lead times.

evidence.claim: Group-owned, list price is policy, no discounts this year
Price changes above 2 % need the pricing committee (biweekly)
Open to discussing logistics and payment conditions
Asked 3.2 %, 1.0 % and 2.8 % in past renewals; settled 0 % each time
Price 684.92 is 1.2 % below the no-margin should-cost of 692.92 (5 % confidence)
OTD 81.5 % against the 95 % target; ppm 0, no complaints in the last 12 months
Focusing on volume customers; we are 0.6 % of its turnover
Contract runs to 2027-06-30 with 12-month auto-extension; prices fixed per calendar year with 90-day change notice

indicators.credit_index: 178 (12 months ago 178; higher is worse, >300 weak)
